questions.text: If you could hide from deadlines for two hours today, which corner wins?

options.label: A quiet nook, laptop open, latte still warm
Plants everywhere, filtered sun, easy to sit for ages
Warm lamps, soft chairs, small talk feels natural
Music with a beat, friends around, photos with real vibe

questions.text: What is sitting on your ideal café table?

options.label: A half-open book and an old-school cup that smells amazing
A clean table, crisp espresso, power outlet nearby
A camera, cute cake, and props for playful shots
A little plant, a stripe of sun, ice melting slowly

questions.text: You open the café door. Which sound says yes?

options.label: Soft keyboard taps, everyone gently focused
Leaves moving, ice touching glass, air feeling fresh
An old record, espresso hum, the day slowing down
Friends laughing just loud enough, playlist lifting the mood

questions.text: A cute café date needs what most?

options.label: Warm light, a small table, no rush to leave
Plants and a nearby walk after coffee
Good photo corners, colorful drinks, stories for the group
Low-key, good coffee, comfortable even solo

questions.text: If rain suddenly arrives, what kind of café do you want to hide in?

options.label: Dry, quiet, with a table where the laptop can stay open
Window seat, rain outside, greenery in view
Warm light, a small dessert, talking until it clears
A big table, friends arriving, rain becoming the excuse

questions.text: Your first order usually says what about the day?

options.label: Filter or espresso, clean and focused
A soft latte, slightly sweet, nice to look at
Old-school milk coffee, familiar and honest
Iced tea, light caffeine, made for lingering

questions.text: If you take one photo there, what should it feel like?

options.label: Clean table, beautiful cup, modern light
Sun through leaves, gentle greens, room to breathe
A little film-like, a little old, slower Saigon
People in frame, natural and fun

questions.text: The café has many empty seats. Which one do you pick first?

options.label: A wall-side corner, low traffic, easy to focus
Near plants or a small patio, some breeze if possible
A soft chair, warm light, comfortable for longer talks
A larger table, useful for friends or spreading things out

questions.text: Which café hour fits you best?

options.label: Early morning, just opened, get things done in one stretch
Late morning, good sun, a gentle reset
Golden hour, pretty light, good for dates or photos
Late enough to be calm, with stories slowing down

questions.text: How do you want to spend on coffee today?

options.label: Friendly price, still fine for studying or working long
A little more is fine if the date feels worth it
As long as the space feels good to stay in
With a group, shared bill and good mood are enough

quiet-work-nook.title: Quiet Work Nook
quiet-work-nook.subtitle: Deep focus, warm coffee, the world turned down.
quiet-work-nook.description: You fit cafés with a softer rhythm, steady tables, kind light, and enough quiet for your brain to settle in. Put the laptop down and the day gets less tangled.
quiet-work-nook.shareTitle: I am a Quiet Work Nook
quiet-work-nook.shareDescription: My café persona: quiet, tidy, ready for deep work after a few sips.

garden-reset.title: Garden Reset
garden-reset.subtitle: Greenery, gentle sun, and room for your mood to breathe.
garden-reset.description: Your mood wants greenery, gentle sun, and room to breathe. The right café lets you sit longer, look at leaves, and make the day feel kinder.
garden-reset.shareDescription: My café persona: plants, sunlight, and a long unhurried sit.

vintage-story-corner.title: Vintage Story Corner
vintage-story-corner.subtitle: Roasted coffee, old wood, and a story moving slowly.
vintage-story-corner.description: You are pulled toward roasted coffee, old wood, slower music, and the feeling that every table has a story. Solo or with company, it has texture.
vintage-story-corner.shareTitle: I am a Vintage Story Corner
vintage-story-corner.shareDescription: My café persona: old-soul rooms, coffee aroma, and a beautifully slow rhythm.
bestFor: a long talk with one person

date-glow.title: Date Glow
date-glow.subtitle: Warm, soft, pretty enough for the conversation to shine.
date-glow.description: Your café match is soft, warm, comfortable, and private enough for conversation to unfold. Pretty, but not trying too hard.
date-glow.shareDescription: My café persona: warm light, a small dessert, and a conversation worth lingering over.
bestFor: an afternoon you want to remember
avoidWhen: it is too loud to hear each other

creative-hangout.title: Creative Hangout
creative-hangout.subtitle: Friends, photos, and energy that arrives right on time.
creative-hangout.description: You need energy, good photo corners, music that lifts the room, and enough space for friends to gather. Coffee should come with sparkle.
creative-hangout.shareDescription: My café persona: good mood, good people, and a few photos that tell the story.

minimal-sprint.title: Minimal Sprint
minimal-sprint.subtitle: Clean, bright, crisp coffee, done and out.
minimal-sprint.description: You fit clean cafés with crisp coffee, quick service, and fewer distractions. Drop in, get things done, caffeinate, move on.
minimal-sprint.shareDescription: My café persona: good coffee, clean table, low friction, and speed.

contribute.heroBody: A Google Maps link, a few honest notes, and real photos if you have them are enough for us to start reviewing. Small contributions help Cafe Maps stay local, warm, and genuinely useful.
